name: Gap holds above prior high, then new session high
hypothesis: If a gap-up stock pulls back but never trades below yesterday's high, the next new session high after 10:00 continues the move.

definition.name: Gap holds above prior high, then new session high

entry.long: session().gap > 0.005 and session().low > session().prev_high and cross_above(close, session().high[1]) and minutes_since_open() >= 30
entry.short: session().gap < -0.005 and session().high < session().prev_low and cross_below(close, session().low[1]) and minutes_since_open() >= 30
